mentions.name: TCG deckbuilding recommender webapp
mentions.description: This webapp applies recommender systems knowledge to trading card game deckbuilding, focusing on Magic: The Gathering. It aims to help with deck construction in a game experiencing product fatigue.
mentions.problem: Magic: The Gathering is suffering from product fatigue.
mentions.source_excerpt: trying to build a webapp where i apply some recommender systems knowledge to TCG deckbuilding. MtG in particular is suffering from product fatigue
